display.purpose: The wordmark 摸鱼阅读 only — the page's single brand moment.

title.purpose: Search-field input text; the largest reading size in the page body.

body.purpose: The page's base size (home.css sets 13px on html/body).

label.purpose: The chrome's base size (base.css sets 12px) plus tile labels and the footnote.

shadows.name: search-focus
shadows.purpose: Focused search field, paired with a transparent border and the 2px accent outline.

shadows.name: current-tile-ring
shadows.purpose: Inset accent ring on the favicon well of the currently-open site.

shadows.name: address-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Soft halo on the chrome address field on focus.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default background/color transition for every control state change.

motion.name: window-fade
motion.purpose: Window opacity fade (FADE_MS), driven by the main process, stepped every 16ms.

motion.name: hide-delay
motion.purpose: Grace period before the body auto-hides (HIDE_DELAY_MS); hide is slow, reveal is fast.

breakpoints.name: compact-height
breakpoints.purpose: @media (max-height: 400px): mini-mode compaction — smaller wordmark, shorter search field, tighter grid, no footnote.

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The start page's signature control: a 46px pill search box, white on a hairline-strong border.
components.html: <form class="ds-search" role="search"><svg class="ds-search-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.5"></circle><path d="M16 16l4 4"></path></svg><input class="ds-search-input" type="text" placeholder="输入网址，或输入关键词搜索" spellcheck="false"></form>
components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; width:100%; height:46px; padding:0 20px; border:1px solid var(--divider-strong,#d1d5db); border-radius:var(--radius-pill,999px); background:var(--ground,#fff); color:var(--text-secondary,#5b6472); transition:box-shadow 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-search:hover { box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(17,24,39,.1); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color:transparent; box-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(17,24,39,.16); outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2563eb); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-search-icon { flex:0 0 auto; } .ds-search-input { flex:1 1 auto; min-width:0; height:100%; border:none; outline:none; background:transparent; font-size:14px; color:var(--text,#111827); } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color:var(--text-tertiary,#6f7683); }

components.name: Site Tile
components.description: An 84px grid cell: a circular favicon well over a 12px label. Hover fills it; the current tile gets an accent ring.
components.css: .ds-tile { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:84px; padding:10px 4px; border:none; background:transparent; border-radius:var(--radius,8px); transition:background 120ms ease-out; } .ds-tile:hover { background:var(--ground-hover,#f3f4f6); } .ds-tile:active { background:var(--ground-active,#e8eaee); } .ds-tile-favicon { width:40px; height:40px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:var(--radius-pill,999px); background:var(--tile,#f1f3f5); overflow:hidden; } .ds-tile-initial { font-size:16px; color:var(--text-secondary,#5b6472); } .ds-tile-label { max-width:100%; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; font-size:12px; color:var(--text-secondary,#5b6472); } .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-label, .ds-tile.is-current .ds-tile-label { color:var(--text,#111827); } .ds-tile.is-current .ds-tile-favicon { background:var(--accent-soft,rgba(37,99,235,.1)); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--accent,#2563eb); } .ds-tile.is-current .ds-tile-initial { color:var(--accent,#2563eb); }

components.name: Toolbar Icon Button
components.description: A 26px chrome control: quiet ink-secondary at rest, hover-gray fill on hover, accent wash when toggled on.
components.html: <button class="ds-iconbtn" title="回到起始页" aria-label="回到起始页"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="15" height="15" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 11.5 12 4.5l8 7v8a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-4v-6H9v6H5a1 1 0 0 1-1-1z"></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-iconbtn { height:26px; min-width:26px; padding:0 6px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:none; background:transparent; border-radius:var(--moyu-radius-sm,4px); color:var(--moyu-text-dim,#5b6472); white-space:nowrap; transition:background 120ms ease-out,color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-iconbtn:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--moyu-surface-hover,#f3f4f6); color:var(--moyu-ink,#111827); } .ds-iconbtn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--moyu-accent,#2563eb); outline-offset:1px; } .ds-iconbtn:disabled { color:var(--moyu-text-faint,#6f7683); opacity:.4; } .ds-iconbtn.is-on { color:var(--moyu-accent,#2563eb); background:var(--moyu-accent-soft,rgba(37,99,235,.1)); }

components.name: Toolbar Text Button
components.description: The chrome's labelled tools (站点 / 历史 / 书签 / 收藏 / 设置), same box as the icon button with 8px padding.
components.css: .ds-textbtn { height:26px; padding:0 8px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:none; background:transparent; border-radius:var(--moyu-radius-sm,4px); color:var(--moyu-text-dim,#5b6472); white-space:nowrap; transition:background 120ms ease-out,color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-textbtn:hover { background:var(--moyu-surface-hover,#f3f4f6); color:var(--moyu-ink,#111827); } .ds-textbtn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--moyu-accent,#2563eb); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Address Input
components.description: The chrome address bar: a 26px rounded field that turns white with an accent border and soft ring on focus.
components.html: <input class="ds-address" type="text" placeholder="输入网址或搜索" spellcheck="false">
components.css: .ds-address { height:26px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--moyu-radius,6px); background:var(--moyu-surface-hover,#f3f4f6); color:var(--moyu-ink,#111827); outline:none; transition:background 120ms ease-out,border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-address::placeholder { color:var(--moyu-text-faint,#6f7683); } .ds-address:hover { background:var(--moyu-surface-active,#e8eaee); } .ds-address:focus { background:var(--moyu-surface,#fff); border-color:var(--moyu-accent,#2563eb); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--moyu-accent-soft,rgba(37,99,235,.1)); } .ds-address:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--moyu-accent,#2563eb); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Tab Chip
components.description: A 26px tab with a close glyph revealed on hover/active; the close hover goes danger-red.
components.css: .ds-tab { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; height:26px; max-width:130px; padding:0 4px 0 9px; border:none; background:transparent; border-radius:var(--moyu-radius-sm,4px); color:var(--moyu-text-dim,#5b6472); transition:background 120ms ease-out,color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-tab:hover { background:var(--moyu-surface-hover,#f3f4f6); color:var(--moyu-ink,#111827); } .ds-tab.is-active { background:var(--moyu-surface-active,#e8eaee); color:var(--moyu-ink,#111827); } .ds-tab-title { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-tab-close { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:var(--moyu-radius-sm,4px); opacity:0; color:var(--moyu-text-dim,#5b6472); } .ds-tab:hover .ds-tab-close, .ds-tab.is-active .ds-tab-close { opacity:.75; } .ds-tab-close:hover { opacity:1; background:var(--moyu-surface-active,#e8eaee); color:var(--moyu-danger,#b91c1c); }

components.name: Segmented Item
components.description: Small chips for opacity presets (清晰/淡化/轻隐/几近无形) and zone toggles (顶部/主体/底部); the selected one takes active-gray with accent text.
components.css: .ds-seg { display:inline-flex; gap:2px; } .ds-seg-item { padding:2px 6px; border:none; background:transparent; border-radius:var(--moyu-radius-sm,4px); color:var(--moyu-text-faint,#6f7683); white-space:nowrap; transition:background 120ms ease-out,color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-seg-item:hover { background:var(--moyu-surface-hover,#f3f4f6); color:var(--moyu-text,#111827); } .ds-seg-item.is-active { background:var(--moyu-surface-active,#e8eaee); color:var(--moyu-accent,#2563eb); } .ds-seg-item.is-off { color:var(--moyu-text-faint,#6f7683); text-decoration:line-through; }

components.name: Opacity Slider
components.description: A 96x3px slider; the track is deliberately gray (not white) so it reads on the white bar, and the thumb is a 12px Focus Blue dot.
components.html: <input class="ds-slider" type="range" min="5" max="100" value="100" aria-label="透明度">
components.css: .ds-slider { width:96px; height:3px; -webkit-appearance:none; appearance:none; background:var(--moyu-border,#d1d5db); border-radius:2px; outline:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance:none; appearance:none; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--moyu-accent,#2563eb); cursor:pointer; } .ds-slider:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--moyu-accent,#2563eb); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
This is a surface that should look like it came with the browser — not like a product someone designed. The commitment, chosen by the user, is canon: the category standard, executed impeccably, without irony or smuggled quirk. The named craft reference is the Chrome / Edge 新标签页 (browser new-tab page): a neutral ground, restrained dividers, a single accent, generous whitespace, an interface that steps back behind the content. Convention is the point, not a compromise — the page is meant to be unremarkable so that it survives being glanced at. At 25–45% opacity beside a Word window, nothing here should identify it as a reading tool (PRODUCT: concealment over beauty; familiarity over novelty).

Density is airy and single-column. A wordmark, one search field, one "continue last" line, a wrapped grid of site tiles, a footnote. The window is a 16:9 frame with two thin toolbars (38px top, 44px bottom) and a fully transparent middle; the chrome was re-skinned to the same palette as the page and recedes to content. The one doctrine: the canon is the commitment — execute the category standard at full fidelity, with no ironic twists and no ornamental deviation.

Provenance note. This world replaced an earlier draft in a different metaphor (a Chinese OMR answer-sheet: cool card stock, registration red, numbered ovals, a 黑体/宋体 split). That draft was abandoned when the user chose canon and is not part of this system. The ordinary look is deliberate, not defaulted-into.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, cool near-black ink ramp, two hairline grays, exactly one blue accent.
No gradients, no glass/blur, no decorative motion, no second accent, no third hue.
System CJK type stack (Microsoft YaHei / PingFang SC / Segoe UI / system-ui); no display face, no webfont.
Flat by default; depth appears only as a response to state (hover, focus, current).
Two surfaces — page (home.css) and chrome (tokens.css) — share one palette and font by construction; they differ only in density (13px page vs 12px chrome base).

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Exactly one chromatic accent exists. #2563eb is used on ≤10% of any given screen and only for focus, current state, and primary action. A second accent or a third hue is the fastest way to stop looking like the browser.

rules.name: The Neutral Ground Rule
rules.body: The page is white and stays white. No tinted canvas, no gradient, no tonal shift to signal depth — the accent is the only color event.

rules.name: The OS-Stack Rule
rules.body: Type is the operating system's. Never ship a display face or a webfont; the page must look like it was rendered by the browser's own engine, because it was.

rules.name: The One-Column Rule
rules.body: One centered column, one grid, no long vertical scroll. Height is the scarce axis in a 16:9 stealth window; content grows sideways, never downward.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow is always a response to state (hover, focus), never a standing decoration.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: No backdrop-filter, no blur, no translucency on any painted layer. The window is transparent by construction; an opaque or frosted layer would break the product.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: All separation is a 1px line or a tonal fill. The only strokes thicker than a hairline are focus rings, and those exist for accessibility under low opacity, not for looks.

dos: Do keep the ground white and the accent singular: #2563eb for focus/current/primary only, on ≤10% of the screen (The One Accent Rule).
Do use the OS CJK stack and only the sizes in the ramp: 12 / 13 / 14 / 30px (The OS-Stack Rule).
Do express every state as a background or outline change at 120ms (fields 140ms) ease-out, in response to hover or focus (The Flat-By-Default Rule).
Do keep the page and the chrome on one palette — they alias identical values by construction. When you touch one, touch the other.
Do keep the chrome's middle fully transparent with pointer-events: none so the mouse reaches the page or the desktop.
Do keep text at 12px or larger and give key controls a shape or position cue, not a color cue, so they stay distinguishable at 25–45% window opacity.
donts: Don't add a second accent or a third hue; the one blue is the whole system (The One Accent Rule).
Don't use gradients, glass, backdrop-filter, or blur — the last is mechanically wrong on a transparent window (The No-Glass Rule).
Don't add decorative motion; state changes are the only transitions, and they do not move anything.
Don't use a display face, a webfont, or glyph/Unicode characters as icons; use the authored 24px / 1.6-stroke SVG set.
Don't smuggle in quirk or irony — toolbars made to look like something else, ornamental asymmetry, or a "designed" flourish. The canon is the commitment.
Don't reintroduce the abandoned OMR answer-sheet world (card stock, registration red, question numbers and ovals, a 黑体/宋体 split); it was replaced by canon and is out of this system.
